[IDAT.3.1] The integrator-visible opaque types of [IDAT.1.2], and the stream
event, a borrowed callback payload: their owning module, their creation /
destruction APIs, and their lifetime class.

| Type              | Owning module | New / free                               | Lifetime class             |
|-------------------|---------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| `ds_engine_t`     | `engine`      | `ds_engine_new()` or `ds_engine_clone()` / `ds_engine_free()` | Engine (integrator-owned)  |
| `ds_fact_t`       | `wm`          | Library-owned; returned by `ds_engine_assert()`'s out-parameter and `ds_engine_fact_find()`, handed to a `ds_engine_for_each_fact()` visitor and in a stream event's payload, and read from a fact-reference slot with `ds_fact_get_slot()` | WM-bound; invalid once its fact leaves working memory ([NFCT.6.2]) |
| `ds_schema_t`     | `schema`      | Library-owned; registered at load, returned by `ds_engine_schema_find()`, `ds_engine_schema_at()` and `ds_fact_get_schema()`, and read as a slot's `schema_ref` with `ds_schema_get_slot()` | Engine |
| `ds_stream_ev_t`  | `recorder`    | Library-owned; borrowed by the stream callback | Valid during the stream callback only |
| `ds_json_t`       | `json`        | Integrator: `ds_json_parse()` / `ds_json_clone()` / `ds_json_new_*()` → `ds_json_free()`; also delivered as library-owned callback-payload borrows | **Dual** — see [IDAT.3.3] |
